messages:
maria.s: Hey team — customer reported they completed signup (Apple Sign-in) and added Apple Pay. 3DS flow showed success, email verified, but onboarding balance is 0. account acct_01F7XYZ — can someone check why the welcome credits didn't apply?

billing-bot: Payment instrument verified: applepay (last4: 4242) — 3DS: success — BIN lookup: 454545 (country: US) — fraud_score: low

alex: Thanks — looping in eng. Can you paste the account payload? I want to check account.flags and promos applied. Quick check: run GET /v1/accounts/{id}/credits — also pasting possible reason: bin-country mismatch or manual_review flag.

maria.s: acct payload snippet: email=jane+test@icloud.com, email_verified=true, country=FR, phone_verified=true, payment_bin=454545, promo_eligibility=unknown, manual_review=true

samr: If manual_review=true the automatic grant is blocked until ops clears. @jordan can you peek at the review flags? If 3DS passed and no open fraud alerts we can manually grant the onboarding 50 credits.

jordan: I see the manual_review flag triggered by BIN mismatch (payment country US vs account country FR). 3DS ok but our policy requires manual review for cross-country BINs. Please attach the 3DS receipt and customer's phone verification timestamp to the ticket and I can approve.

maria.s: attached 3DS receipt (screenshot) and phone verify event id: evt_01G8. Also customer says they used Apple Pay while traveling — billing address is FR.

alex: From an engineering POV there's also a race we sometimes see: promo_apply job runs at signup but defers if manual_review === true at that moment. If manual_review flips to false later the job doesn't re-run automatically. We should either re-run promo apply on manual-review-clear or allow ops to grant credits directly.

support-intern: quick command I ran to check credits status:
```
# check credits
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  "https://api.redwood.com/v1/accounts/acct_01F7XYZ/credits" | jq
```
returned: {"balance":0, "pending_grants":[], "history": [ ... ]}

samr: OK @jordan if you confirm customer identity and 3DS, can you run the manual grant? If ops prefers, eng can re-trigger promo_job for this account. Which is your preference?

jordan: Ops will grant. Granting onboarding bonus (50) after verifying 3DS + phone event. Ticket: TCK-6621.

billing-bot: credits.grant called by jordon.ops — account=acct_01F7XYZ amount=50 reason="onboarding_manual_grant" — status=success — new_balance=50

maria.s: Confirmed with customer — balance shows 50 now. Thanks @jordan and team. I'll update the support case and close. :tada:

alex: We'll follow up with a small infra change: if manual_review flips to false, requeue promo apply job for that account. Created follow-up RFC: RFC-apply-retry-203.

samr: Nice. Also logging note: adding clearer audit entry when promo skipped due to manual_review.

maria.s: closing the thread. Customer happy. ❤️
